title: Set a bindery registration gauge
robot: robosuite PandaOmron with articulated Panda Hand
description: Collect the setting gauge and deliver it across the registration flag to the press fixture.
criterion: The gauge contacts the registration flag and the flag rotates past 0.35 rad.
notes: The receiving station faces 90° away from the pickup station. Both plans carry the same item through the marked aisle checkpoint, turn into the receiving dock and leave for parking after release.
detail: Both cameras show the final receiving station after the payload has settled. The force trace uses each 1 ms solver sample.

steps.text: Leave the dispatch bay and align with the source bench.
Stop at the bench and lower the open fingers around the press setting gauge.
Close the two finger pads and establish a friction grasp.
Lift clear of the source and retract to the transport posture.
Carry the item through the cross aisle.
Dwell at the press aisle marker before continuing.
Align the chassis with the receiving fixture and finish the approach.
Dock at the receiving station and extend the arm.
Push the loaded gauge level across the registration flag.
Open the fingers and let the item settle.
Retract the empty arm to the transport posture.
Drive to the parking bay and stop.

unsafe.outcome: The moving gauge folds the upright registration flag down.
